texto: **Mobil ini sama luasnya dengan mobil itu** and **Mobil ini sebesar mobil itu** express that both have the same amplitude. In the short form, **se-** binds to the adjective.
An announcement may indicate the mark, characteristics, capacity, luggage space, spare parts and consumption. **Irit** describes low fuel use.
